listings.name: 18V brushless cordless drill
listings.description: Two-speed brushless drill with two 2.0Ah batteries, charger and a 40-piece bit set. Used it for decking, shelf brackets and flat-pack furniture; the chuck holds bits tight. Comes in the original hard case.

listings.name: 20V hammer drill and masonry bits
listings.description: Hammer mode makes short work of brick and concrete; drill mode handles timber and metal. Includes two 4.0Ah batteries, a fast charger and a 12-piece masonry bit set. Only used for one bathroom refit.

listings.name: Impact driver with 60-piece bit set
listings.description: Drives long screws and lag bolts without stripping heads. 1/4-inch hex quick-release, two batteries, belt hook and a 60-piece driver set. Handy for fences, garden furniture and decking.

listings.name: 7¼-inch circular saw, corded
listings.description: 1500W circular saw with a fresh 24-tooth blade for ripping timber and sheet goods. Cuts 65mm at 90 degrees. The base plate is slightly scuffed but the shoe still runs square to the blade.

listings.name: Variable-speed jigsaw with blades
listings.description: Cuts curves in plywood, worktops and plastic with the orbital action switched on. Includes 10 assorted blades and a dust port. The plastic base has a crack near the front but it does not affect the cut.

listings.name: 4½-inch angle grinder
listings.description: 900W angle grinder for cutting rebar, grinding welds and stripping paint. Takes 115mm discs. Two guards and a side handle included. The spindle lock sticks a little — hold the disc still when changing it.

listings.name: Random orbital sander, 125mm
listings.description: Smooths filler, paint edges and bare timber quickly. Dust bag and a stack of 80/120/240 discs included. Velcro pad still grabs well. Ideal before varnishing a table or sanding a door frame.

listings.name: Corded reciprocating saw
listings.description: Demolition saw for pruning thick branches, cutting pipe and breaking down pallets. Takes standard reciprocating blades. Includes six wood and metal blades. Loud, so bring ear defenders.

listings.name: Brad nailer and small compressor
listings.description: 18-gauge brad nailer with a 6-litre compressor and 10m hose. Perfect for skirting, architraves and trim without filling hammer marks. Compressor is oil-free and quiet enough for a flat.

listings.name: 2000W heat gun with nozzles
listings.description: Strips paint and varnish, loosens stubborn nuts and shrinks heat-shrink tubing. Two temperature settings with four nozzles. The cable is 3m — you will still want an extension lead outside.

listings.name: Plunge router with 12 bits
listings.description: 1400W plunge router for grooves, rebates, hinge recesses and roundovers. Includes 12 router bits, guide fence and dust extraction port. Depth stop works smoothly; the fine adjuster needs a firm turn.

listings.name: Rotary multi-tool kit
listings.description: Corded rotary tool for detail sanding, cutting and polishing in tight spots. Comes with 40 accessories and a flexible shaft. Great for model work, trimming plastic and cleaning grout.

listings.name: 6-inch bench grinder
listings.description: Two-wheel bench grinder for sharpening chisels, axes and drill bits. One coarse and one fine wheel, plus eye shields. Bolts onto a bench; the left wheel is a little out of round but usable.

listings.name: 10-inch sliding mitre saw
listings.description: Sliding compound mitre saw for skirting, studwork and decking with accurate 45-degree cuts. Laser guide works. Includes a 60-tooth blade and material clamp. Heavy — bring a friend to move it.

listings.name: 94-piece socket and spanner set
listings.description: Chrome vanadium socket set covering 4–32mm with ratchets, extensions and combination spanners. Everything is present and sorted in the case. Ideal for car jobs, bikes and flat-pack assembly.

listings.name: Adjustable spanner set, 3 sizes
listings.description: Three adjustable spanners (150mm, 200mm, 250mm) for plumbing, car repairs and anything without a fixed size. Jaws move freely and grip well. A trace of surface rust on the smallest one.

listings.name: Precision screwdriver set, 60 bits
listings.description: Magnetic precision driver with 60 bits for phones, laptops, glasses and small appliances. Includes Torx, tri-wing and pentalobe. The case hinge is fine; one bit is slightly rounded.

listings.name: 16oz fibreglass claw hammer
listings.description: General-purpose claw hammer for driving nails and pulling them out. Fibreglass handle absorbs shock. The face has a few dings from years of shed projects but the grip is solid.

listings.name: Heavy-duty hacksaw with blades
listings.description: Cuts metal pipe, threaded rod and angle iron. Includes ten 24-TPI blades and a spare frame. Blade tensioner holds well. Best used with a drop of oil on the cut.

listings.name: 14-inch pipe wrench
listings.description: Heavy cast pipe wrench for loosening old plumbing unions and galvanised pipe. Jaws bite hard. The handle has been taped where the original grip wore through — cosmetic only.

listings.name: 1/2-inch torque wrench, 40–210Nm
listings.description: Calibrated click-type torque wrench for wheel nuts, cylinder heads and suspension bolts. Comes with a 1/2-inch to 3/8-inch adapter and a hard case. Last calibrated about a year ago.

listings.name: Pliers and cutters set, 5-piece
listings.description: Long-nose, combination, side-cutting, water-pump and wire-stripping pliers. Insulated handles. The side cutters still slice copper wire cleanly; the spring on the long-nose pair is a bit soft.

listings.name: Wood chisel set, 6-piece
listings.description: Bevel-edge chisels from 6mm to 38mm for hinge mortises, cleaning joints and paring. Honed and ready to cut. Includes a honing guide. Please do not use them on screws or nails.

listings.name: 1200mm spirit level
listings.description: Box-section aluminium level with three vials (horizontal, vertical and 45 degrees). Accurate enough for hanging doors, tiling and shelving. One end cap is missing, so treat the last centimetre as rough.

listings.name: 8m steel tape measure
listings.description: 8-metre auto-lock tape with a magnetic hook and clear metric and imperial markings. The lock holds firmly and the blade retracts smoothly. A budget favourite for measuring rooms and timber.

listings.name: Rolling tool chest with tools
listings.description: Seven-drawer rolling chest on castors, stocked with screwdrivers, pliers, a hammer, a level and assorted spanners. Everything in the photos is included. The top drawer lock is stiff but works.

listings.name: Corded hedge trimmer, 500W
listings.description: 500W hedge trimmer with 55cm double-sided blades. Cuts privet, box and laurel cleanly. 10m cable included. The guard is scuffed but the blades were sharpened last season.

listings.name: Petrol lawn mower, 46cm cut
listings.description: Four-stroke petrol mower with a 46cm deck and a 60-litre grass box. Mulching plug included. Starts on the second pull when cold. Best for medium lawns; the rear roller makes stripes.

listings.name: Cordless grass strimmer
listings.description: Battery strimmer with 30 minutes of runtime per charge and a spare battery. Trims edges, fences and around planters. The spool is easy to refill. Comes with two 2.0Ah batteries and a charger.

listings.name: Electric leaf blower
listings.description: Blows leaves, grass clippings and sawdust off paths and driveways. Variable speed and a vacuum mode with a collection bag. Light enough to use one-handed. Cable is 8m.

listings.name: Petrol chainsaw, 40cm bar
listings.description: 45cc petrol chainsaw with a 40cm bar for logs, storm damage and clearing scrub. One spare chain and a sharpening file included. Starts reliably; the bar oil reservoir needs topping up each use.

listings.name: Electric pressure washer, 130 bar
listings.description: Cold-water pressure washer for patios, driveways, bikes and garden furniture. 130 bar with three nozzles and a 6m hose. The trigger gun drips slightly when released; a new O-ring is included.

listings.name: Galvanised wheelbarrow
listings.description: Steel wheelbarrow with a 65-litre tray and a pneumatic tyre. Hauls soil, compost, gravel and garden waste. The tyre holds air; the tray has one small dent that does not affect use.

listings.name: Garden tool set with border spade
listings.description: Border spade, fork, weed fork and hand trowel with ash handles. Used for planting, edging and turning compost. Cleaned and oiled after each use. The spade edge is sharp — please handle carefully.

listings.name: Bypass secateurs and loppers
listings.description: Bypass secateurs plus long-handled loppers for branches up to 40mm. Both have been cleaned and oiled. The secateurs spring is new; the loppers have a slightly loose pivot that you can tighten by hand.

listings.name: 30m garden hose reel
listings.description: Wall-mounted reel with 30m of reinforced hose, a spray gun and connectors. Fits a standard outdoor tap. The reel swivels smoothly; one connector has been replaced with a brass one.

listings.name: Mini rotavator, petrol
listings.description: Petrol cultivator for breaking up beds, mixing compost and weeding between rows. Starts easily and digs to about 20cm. Foldable handles fit in a car boot. Please use it on dry soil.

listings.name: Telescopic pole pruner
listings.description: Reaches branches up to 4m without a ladder. Telescopic aluminium pole with a bypass cutting head and a pruning saw. The rope and pulley work smoothly. Ideal for fruit trees and hedges.

listings.name: 5.5L stand mixer with bowl
listings.description: Planetary stand mixer with a 5.5-litre bowl, dough hook, whisk and paddle. Kneads bread, creams butter and whips cream without strain. The slow speed is quiet; the head tilt lock is firm.

listings.name: 11-cup food processor
listings.description: Food processor with an 11-cup bowl, chopping blade, dough blade and three discs for slicing and grating. Great for pesto, hummus, pastry and coleslaw. The lid interlock works reliably.

listings.name: High-speed blender, 1.8L
listings.description: 1200W blender that crushes ice, frozen fruit and nuts for smoothies, soups and sauces. Two 1.8-litre jugs included (one with a travel lid). The base is stable and the blades are sharp.

listings.name: 5.8L air fryer
listings.description: Large air fryer with eight presets for chips, chicken, fish and vegetables. Uses far less oil than a fryer and heats up in three minutes. The basket is non-stick and washes easily.

listings.name: Bean-to-cup espresso machine
listings.description: Grinds beans and pulls espresso at the touch of a button, with a steam wand for milk. Includes a tamper and two portafilter baskets. Descaled last month. Please bring your own beans.

listings.name: 6L slow cooker
listings.description: Six-litre slow cooker with low, high and keep-warm settings. Feeds six comfortably — stews, curries, pulled pork and overnight porridge. The ceramic pot and glass lid are both intact.

listings.name: Bread maker with gluten-free cycle
listings.description: Programmable bread maker with 12 cycles including gluten-free, dough and jam. Makes a 1kg loaf overnight. The paddle and measuring cup are included. The non-stick pan is scratch-free.

listings.name: Stainless pasta machine
listings.description: Hand-crank roller for fresh tagliatelle, ravioli and lasagne sheets. Nine thickness settings and a clamp that fits most worktops. Includes a drying rack and a cutter attachment.

listings.name: Ice cream maker, 1.5L
listings.description: Freezer-bowl ice cream maker for gelato, sorbet and frozen yoghurt. The bowl needs 12 hours in a freezer first. Includes a recipe booklet and a spare paddle. Works best with chilled mix.

listings.name: Belgian waffle maker
listings.description: Deep-pocket waffle iron with non-stick plates and a browning dial. Makes two thick Belgian waffles at a time. The plates wipe clean and the indicator light works. Great for weekend brunch.

listings.name: 9-tray food dehydrator
listings.description: Nine-tray dehydrator for dried fruit, jerky, herbs and vegetable crisps. Adjustable thermostat from 35 to 70 degrees and a timer. Trays are dishwasher-safe. Used for two seasons.

listings.name: Sous-vide circulator
listings.description: Immersion circulator that holds water within 0.1 degrees, for steak, chicken and vegetables. Clamps onto any pot. Includes a vacuum-sealed starter bag set. App pairing works but is optional.

listings.name: Cold-press juicer
listings.description: Slow masticating juicer for leafy greens, carrots, apples and ginger. Produces dry pulp and clear juice with minimal foam. All removable parts have been washed. The feed chute is 75mm.

listings.name: 3-person tunnel tent
listings.description: Three-person tunnel tent with two sleeping compartments and a porch for boots and bags. 3000mm hydrostatic head, taped seams and an aluminium pole set. Packs into two stuff sacks.

listings.name: Two-person three-season tent
listings.description: Two-person, three-season tent that pitches in about five minutes. One patched corner on the fly sheet, otherwise waterproof. Includes footprint and pegs. Roomy enough for two adults and day packs.

listings.name: Down sleeping bag, -5°C
listings.description: Mummy-style down sleeping bag rated to -5°C, with a draught collar and a full-length zip. Compresses to about the size of a melon. Recently cleaned and lofted. Suits someone up to 1.85m.

listings.name: Twin-burner camping stove
listings.description: Two-burner gas stove with a piezo ignition and a wind guard. Fits standard camping gas canisters. Boils a litre in under four minutes. The left burner simmers nicely; the right one is hotter.

listings.name: 45L hard cooler box
listings.description: Rotomoulded cooler that keeps ice for up to four days. 45 litres — enough for a family weekend. Has a drain plug and a bottle opener moulded into the lid. One small scuff on the base.

listings.name: Rechargeable headlamp, 400lm
listings.description: 400-lumen rechargeable headlamp with red night mode and three brightness settings. USB-C charging, about six hours on medium. The strap is adjustable and the tilt clicks firmly.

listings.name: Folding camping chairs, pair
listings.description: Two folding camping chairs with cup holders and a carry bag. Steel frame holds up to 110kg. The fabric is clean and the joints are tight. Easy to pack down for the car.

listings.name: Double camping hammock
listings.description: Parachute nylon double hammock with tree straps and carabiners. Sleeps two or one very comfortably. Packs to the size of a grapefruit. The straps are 2.5m each and have no fraying.

listings.name: Aluminium camping table
listings.description: Roll-top aluminium table that folds into a carry bag. Seats four for cooking or cards. The legs lock firmly and the surface wipes clean. A good height for camp chairs.

listings.name: Gravity water filter, 10L
listings.description: Ten-litre gravity filter that removes sediment and bacteria without pumping or power. Flow rate is about a litre every four minutes. Includes a spare filter cartridge. Great for camping and off-grid trips.

listings.name: LED camping lantern
listings.description: Rechargeable LED lantern with four brightness levels and a warm night mode. Runs up to 40 hours on low. USB-C charging and a fold-out hook for hanging in a tent. Two units available on request.

listings.name: Steam cleaner with floor head
listings.description: Pressurised steam cleaner for tiles, grout, oven doors and bathroom seals. Includes a floor head, brush and jet nozzle. Heats up in four minutes. Two microfibre pads are included and washed.

listings.name: Cylinder vacuum cleaner, 2000W
listings.description: Powerful cylinder vacuum with a HEPA filter and a 2.5-litre bag. Strong suction on carpet and hard floors. Includes a crevice tool and an upholstery brush. The hose has no leaks.

listings.name: Carpet and upholstery cleaner
listings.description: Spray-and-extract cleaner for carpets, rugs and sofas. Heats the water and pulls out the dirt. Includes a hand tool for stairs and car seats. The recovery tank seals properly.

listings.name: Wet and dry shop vacuum, 30L
listings.description: 30-litre wet and dry vacuum for sawdust, plaster dust, workshop mess and blocked sinks. Powerful enough for a garage or a renovation. Includes a hose, floor nozzle and a pleated filter.

listings.name: Rotary floor polisher
listings.description: Single-disc rotary polisher for hard floors, tiles and terrazzo. Scrubs, buffs and strips wax. Two pads included. Heavy, but the wheels make it easy to move between rooms.

listings.name: Window cleaning kit, 3m pole
listings.description: Three-metre telescopic window cleaning pole with a squeegee, scrubber and hose adapter. Reaches upstairs windows without a ladder. Includes a bucket and two spare blades.

listings.name: Upholstery spot cleaner
listings.description: Compact spot cleaner for sofa stains, car seats and rugs. Spray, agitate and extract in one pass. Heats the water for better stain lift. The brush attachment is new.

listings.name: Drain cleaning auger, 10m
listings.description: Manual drain auger with a 10m steel cable for sinks, showers and outside drains. The drum feeds and retracts smoothly. Includes a drop head and a boring head. Gloves recommended.

listings.name: Gutter cleaning vacuum kit
listings.description: Gutter attachment set for a wet and dry vacuum: 4m of hose, three shaped nozzles and a shoulder strap. Clears leaves and moss from gutters while standing safely below. Fits most 30–40L vacs.

listings.name: Dehumidifier, 20L per day
listings.description: Extracts up to 20 litres a day from damp rooms, drying laundry and basements. Auto shut-off when full, plus continuous drain hose. Castors and a carry handle. Filter was cleaned recently.

listings.name: 3-ton trolley jack
listings.description: Low-profile 3-ton trolley jack that fits under lowered cars. Lifts to 500mm with a smooth release valve. Includes a rubber saddle pad. Please use axle stands before going under a car.

listings.name: Digital tyre inflator
listings.description: Preset the pressure and it stops automatically. Plugs into the 12V socket and inflates a car tyre in about two minutes. Includes a long hose and a bright LED light. Reads in PSI and bar.

listings.name: OBD-II diagnostic scanner
listings.description: Reads and clears engine fault codes, shows live sensor data and checks emissions readiness. Works with most cars from 2001 onwards. Bluetooth app included. The screen has one small scratch.

listings.name: 12V battery charger and maintainer
listings.description: Smart charger with trickle and repair modes for cars, motorbikes and lawn mowers. Automatically stops when full. Comes with crocodile clips and an eyelet lead. Ideal for a car left standing.

listings.name: Jump starter power pack
listings.description: Portable lithium jump starter for petrol engines up to 6L and diesels up to 3L. Holds charge for months and doubles as a power bank. Includes insulated clamps and a case.

listings.name: 1/2-inch impact wrench
listings.description: Cordless impact wrench with 600Nm of torque for wheel nuts, suspension and rusty bolts. Two batteries and a charger included. Comes with four impact sockets. The battery latch is firm.

listings.name: 4-ton axle stands, pair
listings.description: Two ratchet axle stands rated to four tons each, with a wide base for stability. Adjusts from 280mm to 430mm. Please never rely on a jack alone — these are the safety net.

listings.name: Car ramps, pair
listings.description: Two steel ramps that lift the front wheels about 250mm for oil changes and underside checks. Rubber feet stop them sliding. Rated to 2.5 tonnes per ramp. Best on a flat, hard surface.

listings.name: Telescopic wheel brace
listings.description: Extending wheel brace for stubborn wheel nuts on cars and vans. Fits 17, 19 and 21mm sockets, plus a 1/2-inch drive. The telescope locks positively. Slides under a seat when closed.

listings.name: Car vacuum cleaner, 12V
listings.description: 12V handheld car vacuum with a 5m cable and three nozzles for seats, footwells and boot corners. Strong enough for crumbs and sand. The filter is washable and was cleaned after the last use.

listings.name: Aluminium extension ladder, 3.5m
listings.description: Three-section aluminium extension ladder reaching 3.5m, with a stabiliser bar and rubber feet. Fits in a hatchback when collapsed. The rope and pulley run freely. Please return it dry.

listings.name: 6ft fibreglass step ladder
listings.description: Fibreglass stepladder, six steps, with a fold-out tray for tools. Non-conductive, so it is the safer choice near wiring. Rated to 150kg. The treads and locking arms are in good shape.

listings.name: 8-inch Dobsonian telescope
listings.description: Eight-inch Dobsonian reflector for planets, the moon and brighter deep-sky objects. Comes with two eyepieces, a finder scope and a collimation cap. The base swivels smoothly. Please handle it gently.

listings.name: 1080p home projector
listings.description: Full-HD projector with HDMI and USB inputs, 3000 lumens and a built-in speaker. Throws a 100-inch image from about 3m. Ideal for film nights, football and garden screenings. Remote included.

listings.name: 55-inch 4K TV
listings.description: 55-inch 4K smart TV with three HDMI ports and streaming apps. Sharp picture and even backlight. No stand included — it is set up for wall mounting, but the VESA bracket is here to borrow.

listings.name: Games console with two controllers
listings.description: Current-generation games console with two wireless controllers and a few family games installed. HDMI cable and power supply included. The console is reset to factory settings before each loan.

listings.name: Camera drone with extra battery
listings.description: Foldable camera drone that shoots 1080p video and stabilised stills. Two batteries give about 45 minutes total. Includes a controller, spare props and a carry case. Please check local flight rules.

listings.name: 10-inch tablet
listings.description: Ten-inch tablet with a keyboard case and a stylus. Good for streaming, reading, email and taking notes. Battery holds a full day of light use. Charger and a protective sleeve included.

listings.name: Soundbar with subwoofer
listings.description: Soundbar with a wireless subwoofer for a much clearer film and sport experience. HDMI ARC and optical inputs. Pairs with the supplied remote. The subwoofer needs a nearby power socket.

listings.name: 27-inch QHD monitor
listings.description: 27-inch 1440p monitor with an HDMI and a DisplayPort input, plus a height-adjustable stand. Sharp text for study or work, and 75Hz for casual gaming. Two cables included.

listings.name: Wireless printer and scanner
listings.description: Colour inkjet printer with a flatbed scanner and duplex printing. Connects over Wi-Fi or USB. Takes standard cartridges. The feed rollers work reliably; a new black cartridge is fitted.

listings.name: VR headset, 128GB
listings.description: Standalone VR headset with 128GB of storage and two controllers. Great for games, workouts and virtual tours. Includes a carry case and a lens cleaning cloth. Straps are adjustable.

listings.name: Portable air conditioner, 9000 BTU
listings.description: Portable 9000 BTU air conditioner for bedrooms and small living rooms. Cools, dehumidifies and fans. Includes a window vent kit and a remote. Needs an outside vent; the hose is 1.5m.

listings.name: Smart speaker with screen
listings.description: Countertop smart display that plays music, shows recipes and makes video calls. Works with the main voice assistants. Includes a stand and a charger. Ideal for a kitchen or a home office.

listings.name: 500Wh portable power station
listings.description: Rechargeable power station with AC, USB and 12V outputs. Runs a fridge, a laptop or power tools for a few hours. Charges from mains or a car. Useful for camping, load-shedding or a stall.

listings.name: Folding treadmill
listings.description: Foldable treadmill with 12 programmes and a 12km/h top speed. Folds upright to save space. The belt is clean and runs true. Recommended for walking and light jogging rather than sprint training.

listings.name: Adjustable dumbbells, pair of 24kg
listings.description: Two adjustable dumbbells from 2 to 24kg each, with a quick-dial selector. Replaces a whole rack and fits under a bed. The mechanisms are smooth and the plates are free of rust.

listings.name: Yoga mat and blocks set
listings.description: 6mm non-slip yoga mat with two cork blocks and a strap. Used indoors, cleaned after every session. Rolls up into the included carry strap. Good for yoga, pilates or stretching.

listings.name: Kettlebell set, 6 to 16kg
listings.description: Three cast-iron kettlebells — 6kg, 10kg and 16kg — with a wide handle for two-handed swings. Great for swings, squats, presses and carries. The bases are flat and the paint is intact.

listings.name: Rowing machine
listings.description: Air-resistance rower with a smooth stroke and an LCD monitor showing time, distance and calories. Folds for storage. The seat rolls freely and the chain was oiled recently. Very quiet.

listings.name: Magnetic exercise bike
listings.description: Upright exercise bike with eight resistance levels and a heart-rate display. Adjustable seat and handlebars. Very quiet, so it suits a flat. Castors make it easy to move. Pedals have straps.

listings.name: Resistance band set
listings.description: Five latex resistance bands with different strengths, plus handles, ankle straps and a door anchor. Packs into a small bag for travel or a hotel room. One band shows light wear but still stretches well.

listings.name: Boxing gloves and pads
listings.description: Pair of 12oz boxing gloves with two focus pads and hand wraps. The padding is still firm and the lining has been cleaned. Good for pad work, fitness boxing and learning the basics.

listings.name: Badminton set with net
listings.description: Portable badminton net with two posts, four rackets and a tube of shuttles. Sets up in a garden or hall in about ten minutes. The net has no tears. Rackets are strung and the grips are fresh.

listings.name: Hardtail mountain bike, 29er
listings.description: Large-frame 29er hardtail with a 1x11 drivetrain and hydraulic disc brakes. Tyres have plenty of tread. Recently serviced: new brake pads and a tuned derailleur. Suits riders around 1.80m.

listings.name: Aluminium road bike, 54cm
listings.description: 54cm aluminium road frame with a carbon fork and 22-speed gearing. Light and quick on tarmac. Includes clipless pedals and two bottle cages. A small paint chip on the top tube, no cracks.

listings.name: Bike repair stand
listings.description: Height-adjustable repair stand that clamps the seatpost or frame, leaving both wheels free to spin. 360-degree rotating clamp and a tool tray. Folds flat. Essential for drivetrain and brake work.

listings.name: Floor pump with gauge
listings.description: Steel floor pump with a 160psi gauge and a dual Presta/Schrader head. Inflates a road tyre in a few strokes. The hose is reinforced and the base is stable. Ideal for weekly tyre checks.

listings.name: Tow-bar bike rack, 3 bikes
listings.description: Tow-bar mounted rack that carries three bikes, with a tilt function for boot access and a locking arm. Fits a standard 50mm tow ball. Lights and number plate holder work. Bikes not included.

listings.name: Kids' 20-inch bike
listings.description: Twenty-inch kids' bike for roughly ages six to nine, with six gears, a light frame and training-wheel mounts. Brakes adjusted and tyres pumped. The saddle and grips are in good condition.

listings.name: Adult kick scooter
listings.description: Folding adult scooter with 200mm wheels, a rear brake and an adjustable bar. Folds in one movement for the bus or boot. Good for short commutes and park paths. Weight limit 100kg.

listings.name: Electric city bike, 60km range
listings.description: Step-through electric bike with a 60km assisted range, five power levels and a removable battery. Includes a charger, lights and a rear rack. Brakes and gears were serviced this month.

listings.name: Acoustic guitar with hard case
listings.description: Full-size dreadnought acoustic with a solid spruce top and a warm, balanced tone. Set up with light strings and a low action. Includes a hard case, capo and spare strings. A few honest marks.

listings.name: Electric guitar and practice amp
listings.description: Solid-body electric guitar with a 15W practice amp, a cable and a gig bag. Great for learning chords, recording riffs or playing at a small gathering. Action is comfortable and frets are clean.

listings.name: 88-key digital piano
listings.description: Full-size 88-key digital piano with weighted keys, built-in speakers and a sustain pedal. Headphone output for quiet practice. Includes a stand and a bench. The keys are all responsive.

listings.name: 40W guitar amplifier
listings.description: Forty-watt combo amp with clean and overdrive channels, reverb and a headphone out. Loud enough for a small venue, quiet enough for a bedroom. The speaker has no tears.

listings.name: 12-channel audio mixer
listings.description: Twelve-channel mixer with four mic preamps, two stereo line channels and built-in effects. Perfect for a small gig, a podcast or a school event. Includes a power supply and a manual.

listings.name: DJ controller, 2-channel
listings.description: Two-channel DJ controller with jog wheels, hot cues and a built-in sound card. Connects by USB to a laptop and works with the main DJ software. Includes a carry case and cables.

listings.name: Wireless microphone, pair
listings.description: Two handheld wireless microphones with a receiver, about 50m of range and 8 hours per battery pair. Clear for speeches, karaoke and small events. Includes XLR and jack cables.

listings.name: Powered PA speaker, 12-inch
listings.description: Twelve-inch powered speaker with 400W of output and two mic inputs. Stands on a pole or sits on a table. Good for a party, a market stall or a garden ceremony. Includes a power cable.

listings.name: DSLR camera with 18-55mm lens
listings.description: Entry-level DSLR with an 18-55mm zoom, a spare battery and a 32GB card. Great for portraits, holidays and product photos. The sensor was cleaned recently and the shutter count is low.

listings.name: Mirrorless camera, body only
listings.description: Mirrorless body with a 24MP sensor, 4K video and two spare batteries. Takes the same lens mount as the telephoto in my other listing, so you can borrow both for one trip.

listings.name: 70-200mm telephoto lens
listings.description: Weather-sealed 70-200mm f/2.8 zoom for sport, wildlife and portraits with soft backgrounds. Sharp wide open and the stabiliser works. Includes hood, caps and a padded bag.

listings.name: Carbon fibre tripod
listings.description: Four-section carbon tripod with a ball head and a quick-release plate. Reaches 1.6m and folds to 45cm. Holds a full-frame camera and a heavy lens steadily. Light enough to carry all day.

listings.name: Ring light with stand
listings.description: Eighteen-inch ring light with a 2m stand, phone holder and a bag. Gives even, warm light for portraits, video calls and product shots. Three colour temperatures and ten brightness levels.

listings.name: 3-axis gimbal stabiliser
listings.description: Handheld three-axis gimbal for a phone or a small camera. Makes walking shots and panning video smooth. The motors calibrate in seconds and last about 12 hours. Includes a mini tripod.

listings.name: Instant camera with film
listings.description: Instant film camera with a built-in flash and selfie mirror. Comes with two packs of film (16 shots). Great for weddings, parties and scrapbooks. The film is in date and stored cool.

listings.name: Photo backdrop and stand kit
listings.description: Two-by-three-metre backdrop stand with a white and a grey cloth, plus clips and sandbags. Sets up in ten minutes for portraits, product photos or a party photo booth. Everything packs into one bag.

listings.name: 6ft folding table
listings.description: Six-foot folding table with a wipe-clean top and folding legs. Seats six to eight for a buffet table, a market stall or a card game. The catch on one leg is stiff but it locks safely.

listings.name: Folding chairs, set of 6
listings.description: Six folding chairs with padded seats and a carry strap. Sturdy enough for a garden party and light enough to stack in a shed. The fabric is clean and all hinges are tight.

listings.name: 3x3m pop-up gazebo
listings.description: Pop-up gazebo with a 3x3m canopy, four side panels and leg weights. Sets up in five minutes with two people. Gives shade or rain cover for a garden party or a stall. The bag has a small tear.

listings.name: Disco ball and light
listings.description: Mirror disco ball with a motor and a colour-changing LED pin spot. Fills a room with moving dots. The motor is quiet and the ball is undamaged. Includes a mounting bracket for a ceiling or stand.

listings.name: Chafing dish set, 3 pans
listings.description: Three stainless chafing dishes with lids, water pans and fuel holders. Keeps food warm for hours at a buffet or a party. All pieces are clean and the lids fit well. Fuel canisters not included.

listings.name: Warm-white string lights, 20m
listings.description: Twenty metres of warm-white festoon lights on a black cable, with ten spare bulbs and clips. Indoor or outdoor use. Made a garden party feel like a wedding. The bulbs are all working.
